articles.summary: For several hours on June 30, the dashboard runs list and logs were degraded while your runs kept executing normally. Here's what happened, how we recovered, and what we're changing so it can't happen again.
articles.title: Runs list and logs degraded

articles.summary: On June 22–23, 2026, both of our regions had spells where they couldn't start new runs, and recovery took the best part of a day. Here's what happened, what it cost, and what we're changing so it can't happen the same way again.
articles.title: Incident report on June 22, 2026
